539-1462-3821-4050-4679.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-3821-4050-4679.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

4247-4694-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4247-4694-5805-7306.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1753-3490-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
1753-3490-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2060-4518-7889.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

3298-3368.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Goblins.
3298-3368.description:
Cast Brightstone Ritual by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Brightstone Ritual and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Brightstone Ritual, adding at least six {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1261-5720.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1261-5720.description:
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Time Vault until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by tapping it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

215-850-1753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-1753.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3738-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3738-6797-6972.notes: If Sightless Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

549-2388-6568-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
549-2388-6568-6587.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

141-2921-5188.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-5188.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-3200-7296.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1169-2457-4289-4321.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a Food token and a creature token.
Activate the creature token and Food by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

628-2034-7211.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2099-6972-7155.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

457-1329-2510-3338-7112.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
457-1329-2510-3338-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1492-2866-4050-4986.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-4050-4986.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

565-1858-5998--118.notablePrerequisites: You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
565-1858-5998--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

3951-4192-5147-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Ashes of the Fallen on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-4192-5147-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1251-2525-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2018-5686--73.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
2018-5686--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

4268-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
4268-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2043-5334-6252.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Boommobile that is a 1/1 Soldier artifact creature.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2043-5334-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

457-1409-4321.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token and a Food token.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Construct and Foods, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

575-5256-5624.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Nervous Gardener's power.
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Nervous Gardener triggers, causing you to search your library for a land with a basic land type and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

575-882-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Dwarven Blastminer, adding {R}.
When Dwarven Blastminer dies, Yedora triggers, returning Dwarven Blastminer from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Dwarven Blastminer by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Dwarven Blastminer's morph ability by paying {R}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

224-578-1361-2043.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
224-578-1361-2043.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least three artifact cards from your hand, adding at least six {C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Ancient Den that is a 1/1 Soldier.
When the Ancient Den token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.
If you have four or more artifact cards in hand, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, and you may target any artifact you control to get infinite copies of them.

1061-5131-5186.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn, with {7} plus six {U} available each extra turn
1061-5131-5186.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You do not have any Human, Pirate, or Wizard creature cards in your library
1061-5131-5186.description:
Activate Timstream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Riptide Shapeshifter by paying {2}{U}{U} and sacrificing it, naming any of Timestream Navigator's types, and then revealing Timestream Navigator from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Riptide Shapeshifter from your graveyard by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

232-732-1013-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Hypervolt Grasp attached to Felhide Spiritbinder.
Felhide Spiritbinder does not have summoning sickness.
232-732-1013-1636.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Felhide Spiritbinder triggers, holding priority, activate it by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbinder trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
Repeat from step 3.

1285-1978-3664.notablePrerequisites: Lotus Field does not have summoning sickness.
1285-1978-3664.description:
Activate Mishra's Groundbreaker by tapping and sacrificing it, causing Lotus Field to become a 3/3 artifact creature that's still a land.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Lotus Field.
Repeat from step 2.

245-4152-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has died this turn.
Freed from the Real attached to Undercity Scrounger.
245-4152-4222.description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Undercity Scrounger.
Repeat.

2341-3094-3649.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
2341-3094-3649.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine and The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {3} and tapping them, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

225-539-3861-4770.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{B}
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica.
Repeat.
